context.summary: The lead approved both briefs on 2026-11-20 with "raise the contract decision, don't block" for T-reconcile and "approve + install command" for T-skills. One decision covers both additions to keep the contract change to a single version.

options.tradeoff: Build now; the orchestrator writes v3 from the handoffs and versions it after both PRs merge (as T-log-fixes did). Fast; the text is reviewed with the code.
Write and freeze the v3 text first, then build against it. Safer for parallel consumers, but blocks both tasks on a text-only step.

data.question: T-reconcile adds `ekumen reconcile [--dry-run] [--json]` (loop only) and an orchestrator `brief` inbox action; T-skills adds `ekumen skills list` and `ekumen skills install --dir`. Both change frozen C-cli-json v2. Accept these additions as C-cli-json v3, with the exact text taken from the two tasks' handoffs?
data.title: Add reconcile, skills list and skills install to the CLI contract
